value.rationale: A complete group-diversity feasibility phase diagram, finite-sample error, exact optimum score in distribution and expectation, and simultaneous optimizer characterization directly calibrate the recently introduced quantitative SJR/SSJR problems. The result distinguishes neutral independent approvals from real-world dependent profiles and the nonreentrant fixed-p regime from AJR’s double transition; not an arbitrary parameter slice.
